g.title: seq
g.text: 10b Collection of taxes and customs duties: from the taxpayer to the Treasury Single Account

a.text: 1. Taxpayers and importers to eFPS and
eBIRForms: File the return electronically
2. Taxpayers and importers to Agent banks and
gateways: Pay: bank debit, online gateway, at
a bank branch, or to a revenue collection
officer where there is no bank
3. Agent banks and gateways to Taxpayers and
importers: Payment confirmation
4. Agent banks and gateways to eFPS and
eBIRForms: Report of payments received
5. eFPS and eBIRForms: Post the payment to the
taxpayer account
6. Taxpayers and importers to E2M customs
system: Goods declaration
7. E2M customs system to Taxpayers and
importers: Assessment of duties and taxes
8. Taxpayers and importers to Agent banks and
gateways: Pay the assessed amount
9. Agent banks and gateways to Payment
Application Secure: Abstract of collection,
encrypted and authenticated
10. Payment Application Secure to E2M customs
system: Confirmed payment
11. E2M customs system to Taxpayers and
importers: Release of the goods
12. Agent banks and gateways to Treasury
Single Account: Remit collections to the
account of the Treasury, daily
13. Agent banks and gateways to eTRAMS: Report
of collections to BTr
14. eTRAMS: Monitor collections and
disbursements (eTRAMS)
15. eTRAMS to eFPS and eBIRForms: Compare
remittances with collection reports
16. eTRAMS to E2M customs system: Compare
remittances with collection reports
